explanation: Analyzing disk performance is crucial for understanding overall system performance.  Disk access time is a significant factor impacting I/O-bound applications. Understanding the components of disk access time (seek time, rotational latency, transfer time) allows for performance optimization and informed system design choices. This involves considering different access patterns (sequential vs. random) and their impact on overall performance.
